note: Both sets share the same core claims, including two misread finished-floor values of 2' 3 1/2" (the sheet reads 2' - 9 1/2") and some vague/duplicate entries. Set B adds four claims binding the section-level GRADE LEVEL and FINISHED FLOOR datum markers to individual rooms (Bedroom, Kitchen), which the drawing does not support — those markers are section datums, not room-specific elevations, and the quotes merely concatenate separate labels. Set A stays closer to what the sheet states and avoids these misbound claims, though it also carries redundant Grade Level/Finished Floor restatements. Overall A is the more faithful set.
